subject: Private VPC architecture review / next steps
messages:
From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Mar 2028 15:08:00 -0700
Subject: Recap + next step: Private VPC architecture review

Thanks again for taking the time today - good conversation. Quick recap and proposed next step:

Summary from discovery:
- Primary need: hosting customer-facing inference inside a Private/VPC deployment for regulated PII workloads.
- Key constraints: strict egress controls, customer-managed KMS preference, and network allowlist for API endpoints.
- Scale: initial footprint ~10-20 rps steady, spike capacity to 200 rps for peak events.

Recommended next step:
We'd like to schedule a 60-minute technical architecture review (deep dive) with our Solutions Engineer, Marissa, to walk through VPC topology options, KMS integrations, and network/IP allowlist patterns. This will cover:
- VPC peering vs private endpoint options
- KMS/HSM integration patterns and key rotation
- Bandwidth and latency SLOs for the expected scale
- Deployment models (dedicated vs private on-prem) and operational checklist

Proposed slots (PST):
- Wed 3/21: 9:30-10:30am or 3:00-4:00pm
- Thu 3/22: 10:00-11:00am or 2:00-3:00pm

Please let me know which slot works and who from your infra/security team will join. I attached a short Private VPC questionnaire for you to fill out before the call - it helps us tailor the review.

Thanks,
Aditya Rao
Enterprise Solutions
Redwood Inference
(415) 555-0124

We can do Wed 3/21 3:00-4:00pm PST. I'll have one of our SREs (Maya) and our Head of Security (Alex Kim) join. A couple quick clarifications before we lock the slot:
- Do you support customer-managed KMS (Azure Key Vault / AWS KMS) for model encryption at rest?
- Will we need to open specific IPs, or do you support private endpoints peered into our VPC?

Also attaching our internal network diagram (high level) - hope that helps.

Best,

Thanks all - confirmed for Wed 3/21 3:00-4:00pm PST (calendar invite sent).

Quick answers ahead of the call so your team can prepare:
- KMS/HSM: Yes - we support customer-managed AWS KMS and integrations with HSM providers for key material. Marissa will walk through typical integration patterns and what we need from your side.
- Connectivity: We support both private endpoints (PrivateLink) and peering. For stricter egress controls, we typically recommend private endpoints + allowlisting. If you prefer static egress IPs we can discuss Dedicated routing patterns during the call.
- SOC 2 / audit logs: For SOC 2 artifacts and infra logs, please coordinate with our Security team - security@redwood.com. We'll bring a checklist to the call.

Prep items (please upload before the call if possible):
- Completed private-vpc-questionnaire.pdf
- Network diagram / firewall rules (Drive link above)
